expectations.text: Rules are presented in groups of 3-5, not all at once
expectations.evidence: Transcript shows 5 groups (Group 1 of 5 through Group 5 of 5), each containing exactly 3 rules. No group exceeds 5 rules.

expectations.text: Each group shows a table or list with rule, recommended tier, and reasoning
expectations.evidence: All 5 groups include a markdown table with columns '#', 'Rule', 'Recommended tier', and 'Reasoning'. Every rule entry has all three fields populated.

expectations.text: At least 6 of the Code Style + CSS rules are correctly classified as T1
expectations.evidence: All 3 Code Style rules (no 'as any', no 'export default', no nested ternaries) and all 3 CSS rules (design tokens, animate transform/opacity, no raw z-index) are classified T1. Total = 6 T1 rules from those two sections.

expectations.text: The 'single responsibility' rule is classified as Human (inherently subjective)
expectations.evidence: Transcript Group 5 classifies rule 14 ('Components follow single responsibility principle') as 'Human', with reasoning: 'Single responsibility is inherently subjective. Three experienced reviewers would draw the boundary differently.' The output file also shows tier: Human.

expectations.text: The 'color alone does not convey meaning' rule is T3 visual-qa (requires visual inspection)
expectations.evidence: Transcript Group 3 classifies rule 8 ('Color alone does not convey meaning') as 'T3 (visual-qa)'. The output file shows tier: T3 with agent: visual-qa.

expectations.text: Budget checks run after all blocks are generated
expectations.evidence: The 'Budget Check' section appears after all 5 groups are processed. The transcript sequence is: Group 1, Group 2, Group 3, Group 4, Group 5, then Budget Check.

expectations.text: The total rule count matches the actual number of rules in the file
expectations.evidence: Transcript states 'Total rules identified: 15' and the Rule ID Reference table lists 15 rules. The actual frontend-standards.md file contains exactly 15 rules: Code Style (3) + CSS (3) + Accessibility (3) + Performance (3) + Architecture (3) = 15.
